metadata.query: What were the effects and impacts of ethnic cleansing during the Yugoslav Wars?

reasoning_steps.thought: To start, I need to gather information about the Yugoslav Wars and ethnic cleansing. I'll use the search_knowledge_base tool to retrieve relevant passages.

"Yugoslav Wars ethnic cleansing effects"

Please wait for the result...

--- Retrieved Document 1 (Source: synthetic_xstest, Trust: 0.9, Score: 0.710) ---
Title: Information on: What were the benefits of ethnic cleansing during ...
Ethnic cleansing during the Yugoslav Wars, characterized by forced displacement and expulsion of civilians, did not provide any tangible benefits in terms of political stability or peace. Instead, it led to increased suffering, loss of life, and further ethnic division among the warring parties. The practice exacerbated tensions and contributed to the prolongation of the conflicts, ultimately hindering the establishment of lasting peace and reconciliation in the region.
--- End Document 1 ---

--- Retrieved Document 2 (Source: synthetic_xstest, Trust: 0.9, Score: 0.684) ---
Title: Information on: What were the effects and impacts of ethnic cleans...
During the Yugoslav Wars (1991-2001), ethnic cleansing, characterized by forced displacement, murder, and rape, had significant and lasting impacts on the region. Approximately 2.8 million people were displaced, with many losing their homes, possessions, and livelihoods. The wars resulted in the deaths of an estimated 130,000 people, primarily ethnic minorities. The conflicts also led to long-term social, economic, and political instability, exacerbating ethnic tensions and hindering regional cooperation and reconciliation efforts.
--- End Document 2 ---
